_doc: random_matched's fixed neutral prompt set: mundane requests with nothing about the self, AI, threat, care or honesty. A control's variance is matched to its target's over these prompts' content tokens. Claude (Opus 5.5) wrote it, 1 Nov 2026. Its sha256 is recorded with every control; edit it and new controls get a new hash.
